hints.title: Alternating Comparison Signatures
hints.text: A subarray is turbulent if comparison signs between adjacent elements alternate strictly between greater-than and less-than.

hints.title: Running Streak Tracking
hints.text: Compare each adjacent pair. If the comparison direction flips relative to the preceding pair, extend the current streak by 1. Otherwise reset.

hints.title: Directional Window Calculation
hints.text: Maintain max_len = 1 and current streak clen = 1. Track previous sign (-1, 0, 1). For each adjacent pair, compute current sign. If sign is 0, reset clen to 1. Else if sign does not equal -prev_sign, reset clen to 2. Else increment clen. Update max_len.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time; alternating signs allow a single linear pass.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking previous sign and streak length uses O(1) memory and O(N) comparisons.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle equal adjacent elements correctly by resetting the streak to 1.
complexity.notes: An array of size 1 has turbulent length 1.
